Real-Time Self-Learning Digital Twin

One model. Three jobs. Zero decay.

Built on equation-oriented Aspen HYSYS, the approach that makes plant-wide optimization tractable. The model runs an automated 20–30 minute cycle: reconcile, calibrate, optimize, publish.

  • Ingest — historian data (IP.21 / PI) validated and reconciled automatically.
  • Calibrate — self-learning reconciliation model configured with an innovative
    Rolling-Window Modal Standard Deviation (RWMSD)
    Rolling-Window Modal Standard Deviation (RWMSD) — a short-term variability metric derived from the modal value of a sliding-window standard deviation distribution, giving a stable, outlier-resistant estimate for each tag.
     method that re-tunes parameters to the current plant state.
  • Optimize — the advanced mathematical model finds the most profitable operating point within constraints.
  • Publish — targets and KPIs go to dashboards and APC every cycle.
  • What-if studies — test feed, operating or design changes on the calibrated model before they reach the plant.
Technology stack: Aspen Plus · Aspen HYSYS · Aspen Custom Modeler (ACM) · Aspen Online · MySep Engine
Model acceptance: Material balance: as good as client plant data · Uptime ≥90% · Temperature, Flow: as per RWMSD
Data & visualize: Data Historian · Dashboard technology of client’s choice
Why Anukoolan

Built to stay right, long after go-live

Most plant models are accurate on delivery day, then drift. Ours keep pace with the plant.

Physics first, not curve-fits

First-principles EO models stay valid outside the data they were tuned on. ML is added to complement.

Accuracy that doesn’t decay

Every cycle the model reconciles to live plant data and re-tunes itself, as catalysts age, feeds change and equipment fouls.

Works with your stack

Built on Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus, ACM and Aspen Online, with MySep for separation, and connected to your historian and dashboards.

Proven in live operation

25+ real-time models in 10 countries, averaging about 1,600 instrument tags each, across LNG, refining, gas processing and petrochemicals.

How an engagement runs

A clear path from first data review to a model that keeps paying back.

01

Assess

Review process data, tags and economics. Agree KPIs and the value case.

→ Scope & value case
02

Build

Build a first-principles model of each unit; validate against heat and material balance.

→ Validated model
03

Calibrate

Reconcile to plant data and tune until the model meets the acceptance criteria.

→ Plant-matched twin
04

Deploy

Run it online, advisory or closed-loop, publishing targets and KPIs to dashboards and APC.

→ Live optimization
05

Sustain

Monitor, re-tune and extend with what-if studies.

→ Lasting results
